description:
## Problem
The released CLI in `benchbox/cli/commands/submit.py` prints `PR target: published-results` in its `Next steps` output and writes `Open a pull request against the published-results branch` into the generated submission `README.md`. Core `results-data/README.md` also directs contributors to `published-results`. Until a core release updates `benchbox submit`, users on 0.5.x will keep opening PRs against `published-results`.

## Change
1. Update `benchbox/cli/commands/submit.py` (both the generated submission `README.md` template and the CLI `Next steps` console output) to target `develop` instead of `published-results`, noting that bundle PRs undergo manual review.
2. Update core `results-data/README.md` to document the `develop` PR submission flow cleanly.
3. Update and add unit tests asserting the new `develop` PR target output, and add a `changelog.d/` fragment.

## Decision gates
- Do not change `benchbox submit` CLI option names, manifest schema, validation rules, or exit codes without owner approval.
- Confirm Step 2 (`corpus-intake-on-develop-20261124`) is merged on `develop` before merging this PR so contributors directed to `develop` hit the working validator and no-auto-merge guard.
- Note for release coordination: Step 5 (`retire-published-results-mirror-and-freeze-20261124`) must not start until a tagged core release includes this change.

## Verification rubric
- Pass: unit tests assert `PR target: develop` and the generated README target `develop` (and fail against the old `published-results` output); `rg 'published-results' benchbox/cli/commands/submit.py` returns 0 matches; `changelog.d/` fragment passes `make changelog-check`; `make pr-preflight` and hosted `review-gate` pass.
- Fail: any user-facing output from `benchbox submit` still names `published-results`, or the PR ships without a `changelog.d/` fragment.

## Guardrails
Work in a linked worktree (`make worktree-create`), never the primary clone. No explanatory comments or docstrings in first-party Python (`make comment-policy-check`). Stage named paths only; commit with pinned human Git identity and no agent attribution or session labels. Heavy work only via `make pr-preflight` / `make heavy-run`; never bypass `~/.benchbox/test.lock`. Open with `make pr-open`, arm with `make pr-arm`, and monitor to merge.
